name: Loom
tagline: Seven cards, nine cells: close a poker thread and it pays at once, but the leader drafts last.
core_loop: Each round a shared market of P+1 face-up cards is revealed and the draft order is recomputed with the lowest banked score first; on their turn a player draws one market card, announces whether they weave that drawn card face-up or bury their hidden hand card face-down, and places it in an empty cell of their 3x3 weave, banking at once any row, column or diagonal that this completes.
win_condition: The loom is cut after 7 rounds, so two cells of every 3x3 grid stay bare and threads through them score nothing; the highest banked total from completed threads wins.
